kg_child_context_reason: The fragments instantiate aes_sbox and depend on its exact combinational port names, widths, and interface. Child context is also material because the module plan requests one S-box instance while the generated datapath contains four instances.
code_gap_notes: No candidate provides a complete aes_key_expand port declaration; the merge must resolve clk, rst, kld, initial_key, and round_key directions and widths from the module skeleton and plan.
The fragments conflict on S-box structure: the declaration fragment creates one instance, while the datapath fragment adds three more despite the stated single-instance constraint.
The registered round_key timing is ambiguous: initial key loading does not update round_key, and expansion assigns the pre-update words because of nonblocking assignment semantics.
Reset is implemented as synchronous active-high reset, but that polarity and timing are not explicitly defined in the candidate specification blocks.
Expansion enable and completion behavior are only implied by kld deassertion and rcnt reaching 10; there is no explicit done or valid output contract.
selection_reason: S004 defines RotWord, SubWord, Rcon placement, and the AES word recurrence directly implemented by the combinational datapath.
S005 is the closest available current-module operational interface block: it defines kld-controlled expansion and the required next-word XOR sequence.
S006 defines round-constant initialization, byte placement, and per-round progression needed to merge the Rcon logic.
S008 defines rcnt width-relevant range, reset behavior under kld, increment timing, and the ten-round stopping boundary.
S010 defines the aes_sbox as a purely combinational byte lookup, which is needed when merging and wiring the child instances.
